description: Set where the game's highlights post: a Discord channel webhook (Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy URL) or a Slack incoming webhook. Server logic posts with highlight(type, text, data), e.g. highlight("hard-clear", "Mia cleared Level 9 on one life"); the server decided it happened, so players can't fake one. Sends a test post and saves only if it is accepted. The URL is a credential: ask the user to paste it, and it is only ever shown back masked. Pass null to stop posting. Limits: 6 highlights a minute per room, 60 posts an hour per game (the rest are still recorded; see get_live_ops).

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

url.description: https://discord.com/api/webhooks/… or https://hooks.slack.com/services/…, or null to clear.

name: set_highlight_webhook
title: Post highlights to Discord or Slack
